startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Websites to crawl, e.g. leads' homepages from the Google Maps Leads Searcher or LinkedIn Leads Collector. Only same-origin links are followed.

maxDepth.title: Crawl depth
maxDepth.description: How many link levels to follow from each start URL (0 = only the start page). Contact/About/Team pages are crawled first at every level.
maxDepth.sectionDescription: Lower budgets are faster and cheaper; most business emails live on contact pages within depth 2.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages crawled per run (all start URLs combined).

excludeRoleEmails.title: Exclude role emails
excludeRoleEmails.description: Skip generic addresses like info@, sales@, support@ - keep only person-style addresses.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies help with sites behind anti-bot protection.
